1001.translation: And Allāh wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak.

They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."

1002.translation: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture, who believe in jibt [superstition] and ṭāghūt [false objects of worship] and say about the disbelievers, "These are better guided than the believers as to the way"?

1003.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

1004.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.

1005.translation: But you wonder, while they mock,
Then at this statement do you wonder?

1006.translation: And whoever does that in aggression and injustice - then We will drive him into a Fire. And that, for Allāh, is [always] easy.
And you see many of them hastening into sin and aggression and the devouring of [what is] unlawful. How wretched is what they have been doing.

1007.translation: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

1008.translation: And they who guard their private parts
And those who guard their private parts

1009.translation: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allāh], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle [i.e., ʿaṣr] prayer and stand before Allāh, devoutly obedient.

1010.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

1011.translation: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

1012.translation: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

1013.translation: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

1014.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

1015.translation: And when you call to prayer, they take it in ridicule and amusement. That is because they are a people who do not use reason.
And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?

1016.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

1017.translation: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
And this [Qur’ān] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

1018.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other.
Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

1019.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
Indeed, Allāh does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

1020.translation: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

1020.gloss: And (prohibited are) the ones who are married
1020.translation: And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess. [This is] the decree of Allāh upon you. And lawful to you are [all others] beyond these, [provided] that you seek them [in marriage] with [gifts from] your property, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse. So for whatever you enjoy [of marriage] from them, give them their due compensation as an obligation. And there is no blame upon you for what you mutually agree to beyond the obligation. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

1021.translation: So they turned away from him, departing.
And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

1022.translation: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

1023.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."

1024.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.

1025.translation: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

But if bounty comes to you from Allāh, he will surely say, as if [i.e., showing that] there had never been between you and him any affection, "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."

1026.translation: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

1027.translation: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

1028.translation: O you who have believed, take your precaution and [either] go forth in companies or go forth all together.
Go forth, whether light or heavy, and strive with your wealth and your lives in the cause of Allāh. That is better for you, if you only knew.

1029.translation: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allāh was their ally; and upon Allāh the believers should rely.

And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof [i.e., sign] of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.

1030.translation: By the star when it descends,

[Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."

1031.translation: Prescribed for you when death approaches [any] one of you if he leaves wealth [is that he should make] a bequest for the parents and near relatives according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.

O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allāh if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange it [i.e., our oath] for a price [i.e., worldly gain], even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of [i.e., ordained by] Allāh. Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."

1032.translation: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.

1033.translation: Then he desires that I should add more.
And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

1034.translation: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

1035.translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

1036.translation: And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.

1037.translation: [Allāh] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time."
We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

1039.translation: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allāh and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"

1040.translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

1041.translation: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."

1042.translation: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

1043.translation: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.
And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.

1044.translation: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.

We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil [i.e., insanity]." He said, "Indeed, I call Allāh to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allāh

1045.translation: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

1046.translation: Then depart from the place from where [all] the people depart and ask forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

1047.translation: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.
It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

1048.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

1049.translation: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.

1050.translation: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

1051.translation: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]
The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

1052.translation: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.

And if you fear dissension between the two, send an arbitrator from his people and an arbitrator from her people. If they both desire reconciliation, Allāh will cause it between them. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Aware.

1053.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"

And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

1054.translation: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding -

1055.translation: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allāh. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

1056.translation: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."

1057.translation: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged.

1058.translation: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
And what struck you on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] was by permission of Allāh that He might make evident the [true] believers

1059.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].

1060.translation: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

1061.translation: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.

1062.translation: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"

1063.translation: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

1064.translation: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.

1065.translation: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

O you who have believed, spend from that which We have provided for you before there comes a Day in which there is no exchange [i.e., ransom] and no friendship and no intercession. And the disbelievers - they are the wrongdoers.

1066.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
[This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.

1067.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

1067.gloss: They will pass to one another
1067.translation: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

1068.translation: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

1069.translation: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
Indeed, those who disbelieve [i.e., reject the message] after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray.

1070.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

1071.translation: So be patient with gracious patience.
And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

1072.translation: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

1073.translation: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

1074.translation: And caused to grow within it grain
And grain having husks and scented plants.

1075.translation: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

1076.translation: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

1077.translation: Say, "With Allāh is the far-reaching [i.e., conclusive] argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all."
[We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allāh after the messengers. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

1078.translation: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

1079.translation: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

And when [other] relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the [time of] division, then provide for them [something] out of it [i.e., the estate] and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.

1080.translation: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."

1081.translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.

1082.translation: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.

And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.

1083.translation: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

1084.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
[They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.

1085.translation: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

1086.translation: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

1087.translation: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.

1088.translation: Allāh destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allāh does not like every sinning disbeliever.
O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allāh that you may be successful.

1089.translation: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
And everything they did is in written records.

1090.translation: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.

1091.translation: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

1092.translation: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].

1093.translation: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].

1094.translation: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."

Had it been a near [i.e., easy] gain and a moderate trip, they [i.e., the hypocrites] would have followed you, but distant to them was the journey. And they will swear by Allāh, "If we were able, we would have gone forth with you," destroying themselves [through false oaths], and Allāh knows that indeed they are liars.

1095.translation: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
And do not give the weak-minded your property, which Allāh has made a means of sustenance for you, but provide for them with it and clothe them and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.

1096.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
[Allāh] said, "Then indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years [in which] they will wander throughout the land. So do not grieve over the defiantly disobedient people."

1097.translation: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allāh that perhaps they will remember.

1098.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.

1099.translation: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

1100.translation: And the stars and trees prostrate.
Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

1101.translation: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
That is [deserved by them] because Allāh has sent down the Book in truth. And indeed, those who differ over the Book are in extreme dissension.

1102.translation: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

1103.translation: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

1104.translation: And you laugh and do not weep
So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

1105.translation: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.

1106.translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."

1107.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

1108.translation: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

1109.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
Say, "If Allāh had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason?"

1110.translation: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

1111.translation: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

1112.translation: He only orders you to evil and immorality and to say about Allāh what you do not know.
Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

1113.translation: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.
And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

1114.translation: And if they had intended to go forth, they would have prepared for it [some] preparation. But Allāh disliked their being sent, so He kept them back, and they were told, "Remain [behind] with those who remain."
They said, "O Moses, indeed we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are within it; so go, you and your Lord, and fight. Indeed, we are remaining right here."

1115.translation: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."

The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?" Say, "To Allāh belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."

1116.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

1117.translation: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.

1118.translation: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

1119.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
And he showed him the greatest sign,

1120.translation: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

1121.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Aware.

1122.translation: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

1123.translation: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].

1124.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

1125.translation: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."

1126.translation: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].
Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

1127.translation: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.

1128.translation: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
Have We not made the earth a resting place?

1129.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

1130.translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]

1131.translation: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

And if you divorce them before you have touched them and you have already specified for them an obligation, then [give] half of what you specified - unless they forego the right or the one in whose hand is the marriage contract foregoes it. And to forego it is nearer to righteousness. And do not forget graciousness between you. Indeed Allāh, of whatever you do, is Seeing.

1132.translation: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.

1133.translation: Allāh has made the Kaʿbah, the Sacred House, standing for the people and [has sanctified] the sacred months and the sacrificial animals and the garlands [by which they are identified]. That is so you may know that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and that Allāh is Knowing of all things.

They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

1134.translation: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

1135.translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

1136.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?

1137.translation: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

That they may bear their own burdens [i.e., sins] in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without [i.e., by lack of] knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

1138.translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
They receive good tidings of favor from Allāh and bounty and [of the fact] that Allāh does not allow the reward of believers to be lost -

1139.translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."

1140.translation: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
[But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

1141.translation: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

1142.translation: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

1144.translation: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].

1145.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

1146.translation: Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Aware.
It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

1147.translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

1148.translation: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

1149.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

1150.translation: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,

1151.translation: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

It [i.e., Paradise] is not [obtained] by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does a wrong will be recompensed for it, and he will not find besides Allāh a protector or a helper.

1152.translation: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -

1153.translation: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."

They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allāh makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

1154.translation: And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

1155.translation: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
[It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].

1156.translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

1157.translation: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

Would you not fight against a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun [the attack upon] you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allāh has more right that you should fear Him, if you are [truly] believers.

1158.translation: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

[You disbelievers are] like those before you; they were stronger than you in power and more abundant in wealth and children. They enjoyed their portion [of worldly enjoyment], and you have enjoyed your portion as those before you enjoyed their portion, and you have engaged [in vanities] like that in which they engaged. [It is] those whose deeds have become worthless in this world and in the Hereafter, and it is they who are the losers.

1159.translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

1160.translation: So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allāh like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allāh and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination.
Indeed, I want you to obtain [thereby] my sin and your sin so you will be among the companions of the Fire. And that is the recompense of wrongdoers."

1161.translation: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

1162.translation: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest

Indeed, Allāh has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allāh, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur’ān. And who is truer to his covenant than Allāh? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment.

1163.translation: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"

[He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people [i.e., the king and his court]; perhaps they will know [about you]."

1164.translation: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

1165.translation: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
[Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.

1166.translation: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander
And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

1167.translation: And [remember] when you, [O Muḥammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uḥud] - and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing -

And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.

1168.translation: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,

1169.translation: And among them are those who made a covenant with Allāh, [saying], "If He should give us from His bounty, we will surely spend in charity, and we will surely be among the righteous."
And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew.

1170.translation: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.

1171.translation: And the earth discharges its burdens
We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

1172.translation: They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allāh makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

1173.translation: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

1174.translation: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.

1175.translation: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
And eat of what Allāh has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.

1176.translation: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

1177.translation: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

1178.translation: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."
And indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., Makkah] to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.

1179.translation: And when you have completed your rites, remember Allāh like your [previous] remembrance of your fathers or with [much] greater remembrance. And among the people is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world," and he will have in the Hereafter no share.

Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allāh and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allāh will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.

1180.translation: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?"

1181.translation: O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allāh], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful.

O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire."

1182.translation: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

1183.translation: [Allāh] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."
And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

1184.translation: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

1185.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
Indeed, Allāh does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

1186.translation: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

1187.translation: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

1188.translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
[Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.

1189.translation: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

1190.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

1191.translation: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

1192.translation: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allāh, the One, the Prevailing?
He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."

1193.translation: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,

1195.translation: But if they separate [by divorce], Allāh will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allāh Encompassing and Wise.

Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].

1196.translation: Then Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and sent down soldiers [i.e., angels] whom you did not see and punished those who disbelieved. And that is the recompense of the disbelievers.

It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.

1197.translation: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.
O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].

1198.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.

1199.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

1200.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
[Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

1201.translation: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

1202.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

1203.translation: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].

And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.

1204.translation: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

1205.translation: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

1206.translation: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

1207.translation: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

1208.translation: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
Satan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and to avert you from the remembrance of Allāh and from prayer. So will you not desist?

1209.translation: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
[Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

1210.translation: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world, but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

Had it been a near [i.e., easy] gain and a moderate trip, they [i.e., the hypocrites] would have followed you, but distant to them was the journey. And they will swear by Allāh, "If we were able, we would have gone forth with you," destroying themselves [through false oaths], and Allāh knows that indeed they are liars.

1211.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
"Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured." And excellent is the final home.

1212.translation: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

1213.translation: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

1214.translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

1215.translation: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

But whoever kills a believer intentionally - his recompense is Hell, wherein he will abide eternally, and Allāh has become angry with him and has cursed him and has prepared for him a great punishment.

1216.translation: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

1217.translation: And remove the fury in their [i.e., the believers'] hearts. And Allāh turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
Who spend [in the cause of Allāh] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;

1218.translation: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

[He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

1219.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.

1220.translation: And when the seas are erupted
A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

1221.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

1222.translation: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
[Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.

1223.translation: Zakāh expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed for it and for bringing hearts together [for Islām] and for freeing captives [or slaves] and for those in debt and for the cause of Allāh and for the [stranded] traveler - an obligation [imposed] by Allāh. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

There is no blame upon you if you divorce women you have not touched nor specified for them an obligation. But give them [a gift of] compensation - the wealthy according to his capability and the poor according to his capability - a provision according to what is acceptable, a duty upon the doers of good.

1224.translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.

1225.translation: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

1226.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

1227.translation: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,

1228.translation: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allāh. And indeed, Allāh is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

1229.translation: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."

1230.translation: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."
Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."

1231.translation: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allāh, the One, the Prevailing?
[It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,

1232.translation: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

1233.translation: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.

1234.translation: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

1235.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."

1236.translation: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

1237.translation: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

1238.translation: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

1239.translation: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.

1239.gloss: and will cause them to meet
1239.translation: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

1240.translation: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.
O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

1241.translation: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakāh] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.

And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

1242.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

1243.translation: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.

1244.translation: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

1245.translation: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors.

1246.translation: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.

1247.translation: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.

Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."

1248.translation: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

1249.translation: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

1250.translation: And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
